items.source: A StompSession that implements TcpConnectionHandler in order to send and receive messages.
items.translation: 一个实现了TcpConnectionHandler的StompSession，用于发送和接收消息。

items.source: An overloaded version of WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, StompSessionHandler, Object...) that also accepts WebSocketHttpHeaders to use for the WebSocket handshake.
items.translation: 一个重载版本的WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, StompSessionHandler, Object...)，它也接受用于 WebSocket 握手的WebSocketHttpHeaders。

items.source: Connect and notify the given StompSessionHandler when connected on the STOMP level.
items.translation: 连接并在 STOMP 级别建立连接时通知给定的StompSessionHandler。

items.source: Connect to the given WebSocket URL and notify the given StompSessionHandler when connected on the STOMP level after the CONNECTED frame is received.
items.translation: 连接到给定的 WebSocket URL，并在收到 CONNECTED 帧后在 STOMP 级别建立连接时通知给定的StompSessionHandler。

items.source: Uses of StompSession in org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp
items.translation: StompSession 在 org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp 中的用法

items.source: Uses of StompSession in org.springframework.web.socket.messaging
items.translation: `StompSession`接口在org.springframework.web.socket.messaging中的用法

items.source: An overloaded version of WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, StompSessionHandler, Object...) that also accepts WebSocketHttpHeaders to use for the WebSocket handshake and StompHeaders for the STOMP CONNECT frame.
items.translation: 一个重载版本的 WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, StompSessionHandler, Object...)，它也接受用于 WebSocket 握手的 WebSocketHttpHeaders 和用于 STOMP CONNECT 帧的 StompHeaders。

items.source: An overloaded version of WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, WebSocketHttpHeaders, StompSessionHandler, Object...) that accepts a fully prepared URI.
items.translation: 一个重载版本的WebSocketStompClient.connectAsync(String, WebSocketHttpHeaders, StompSessionHandler, Object...)，它接受一个完全准备好的URI。

items.source: An overloaded version of ReactorNettyTcpStompClient.connectAsync(StompSessionHandler) that accepts headers to use for the STOMP CONNECT frame.
items.translation: 一个重载版本的 ReactorNettyTcpStompClient.connectAsync(StompSessionHandler)，用于接受 STOMP CONNECT 帧要使用的标头。

items.source: Handle any exception arising while processing a STOMP frame such as a failure to convert the payload or an unhandled exception in the application StompFrameHandler.
items.translation: 处理处理 STOMP 帧时出现的任何异常，例如无法转换负载或在应用程序StompFrameHandler中未处理的异常。

items.source: Generic support for simple messaging protocols (like STOMP).
items.translation: 支持简单消息协议（如 STOMP）的通用功能。

items.source: WebSocket integration for Spring's messaging module.
items.translation: Spring 消息模块的 WebSocket 集成。

items.source: Return a future that will complete when the session is ready for use.
items.translation: 返回一个未来对象，当会话准备好使用时将完成。

items.source:
Handle a low level transport error which could be an I/O error or a
failure to encode or decode a STOMP message.
items.translation: 处理低级传输错误，该错误可能是 I/O 错误或无法对 STOMP 消息进行编码或解码。
